releases.name: x402-mcp-client
releases.title: x402-paying MCP client with hard spending limits
releases.summary: Adds an x402-paying MCP client (@x402/mcp x402MCPClient with ExactEvmScheme) that pays USDC on Arbitrum Sepolia only to allowlisted recipients, within a per-call cap and a total budget enforced in code before any payment is signed.

provenance.attribution: x402 Foundation, x402 TypeScript SDK (@x402/core, @x402/evm, @x402/mcp 2.27.0; tag npm-@x402/mcp@v2.27.0, formerly coinbase/x402). Licensed under Apache-2.0.
provenance.modifications: Composes the upstream x402MCPClient, x402Client policies and payment-creation hooks into a spend ledger that reserves budget synchronously before signing, restricts network, asset and recipient, adds a connectPayingAgent entry point to the agent, and adds an offline acceptance test against an in-process paid MCP server.

limitations: Testnet only: Arbitrum Sepolia USDC, exact scheme, x402 protocol v2.
The spend ledger is in-memory; persist it to enforce a daily cap across process restarts.
A signed payment counts against the budget even if the response is lost (fail-closed).
The modify operation requires src/agent.ts to match the reviewed base byte for byte; drift stops application.
Savings are not yet benchmarked; evidence is provisional.

releases.name: x402-mcp-server
releases.title: x402 payment gating for a TypeScript MCP server
releases.summary: Adds per-call x402 payment gating (exact scheme, USDC on Arbitrum Sepolia, chain 421614) to tools of a TypeScript MCP server built on @modelcontextprotocol/sdk McpServer.registerTool, using @x402/mcp createPaymentWrapper with an x402ResourceServer and a configurable facilitator.

provenance.attribution: x402 Foundation, x402 TypeScript SDK (@x402/core, @x402/evm, @x402/mcp 2.27.0; tag npm-@x402/mcp@v2.27.0, formerly coinbase/x402). Licensed under Apache-2.0.
provenance.modifications: Wraps the upstream createPaymentWrapper/x402ResourceServer/ExactEvmScheme server APIs in a lazily initialised paywall module pinned to Arbitrum Sepolia USDC, adds environment configuration and input validation, wires it into the server's premium tool, and adds an offline acceptance test with an in-process facilitator.

limitations: Testnet only: Arbitrum Sepolia USDC, exact scheme, x402 protocol v2.
Paid tools must declare an inputSchema; the MCP SDK passes request metadata only to schema-bearing tools.
The modify operation requires src/server.ts to match the reviewed base byte for byte; drift stops application.
Production use requires X402_FACILITATOR_URL and X402_PAY_TO; settlement depends on the configured facilitator.
Savings are not yet benchmarked; evidence is provisional.
